name: A Teaspoon of Transcendence
effectTemplate:
ATK is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>.
Additionally, each time the equipping character hits an opponent with their Charged Attack, they attain "Transcendence" for a short time: their Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color> for 5s. This effect can stack once every 0.2s, max 3 stacks.
